newsitem.title: UK: Lehman sets warrants on eight German companies.
newsitem.headline: Lehman sets warrants on eight German companies.

text.p: Lehman Brothers Finance has issued American-style call warrants, on various German companies from the chemical, automotive and banking sectors, lead manager Lehman Brothers Bankhaus AG said.
There are eight tranches, each of five million warrants on BASF AG, Bayer AG, Hoechst AG, BMW AG, Daimler-Benz AG, Volkswagen AG, Commerzbank AG and Deutsche Bank AG.
